about: compiler/testexec: data-oriented test/law discovery, regex selection, LPT sharding, deterministic harness/lib emission, build/run planning, and verdict aggregation (SELFHOST-TEST-RUNNER).

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-discover-drops-member-laws
mutants.from:
Kind:       uint8(2),
									Flags:      flags,
									Name:       mName,
									Title:      tName + "." + mName,
mutants.to:
Kind:       uint8(1),
									Flags:      flags,
									Name:       mName,
									Title:      mName,
mutants.rule: DiscoverObligations extracts interface member law declarations as Kind 2 with qualified Type.Law titles.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-discover-unsorted-tests
mutants.to:
let sortedTestsUnused = slices.SortFunc(tests, compareTestItems)
	let _ = sortedTestsUnused
mutants.rule: Package test obligations are sorted canonically so file traversal order never changes obligation ordering.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-select-ignores-skip-filter
mutants.from: let outMatch = hasSkip && matchesObligation(true, skipProg, spec.Skip, title, full)
mutants.to: let outMatch = false && hasSkip && matchesObligation(true, skipProg, spec.Skip, title, full)
mutants.rule: SelectObligations excludes obligations matched by --skip into SkippedIDs.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-select-allows-bad-quantifier
mutants.rule: Unattached and stacked repetition quantifiers (*leading, a++) are rejected with PatternError.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-shard-merges-all-into-first
mutants.rule: PlanShards balances items across lightest shards rather than assigning all targets to shard 0.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-harness-drops-seed-replay
mutants.from: let seedPart = if seed > uint64(0) { " --seed " + u64Decimal(seed) } else { "" }
mutants.rule: Replay commands embed --seed N when non-zero seed is provided.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-harness-allows-main-lib
mutants.rule: ValidateLibPackageName rejects `main` as an invalid Go library package name.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-verdict-bad-json-escape
mutants.rule: FormatVerdictJSON encodes strings using RFC 8259 JSON escaping so control bytes remain valid JSON.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-verdict-priority-wrong
mutants.rule: Defect/usage exit status 2 takes precedence over test failure status 1 in RollupVerdicts.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-plan-allows-dir-output
mutants.rule: ResolveOutputPath rejects trailing-slash directory paths with PlanError E_OUTPUT.
